newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TENERIFE BEAT LAZIO 5-3 IN ACTION-PACKED THRILLER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TENERIFE BEAT LAZIO 5-3 IN ACTION-PACKED THRILLER.

text.p: Spain's Tenerife took their place in the third round of the UEFA Cup after beating Lazio 5-3 in an action-packed and at times bizarre game on Tuesday.
With a 1-0 win from the first leg, Lazio looked to have the tie wrapped up when Tenerife goalkeeper Marcelo Ojeda was beaten by a superb shot by Nedved with just 13 minutes on the clock.

But Tenerife struck straight back thanks to an own goal by Alessandro Nesta, and went ahead through Meho Kodro when the Bosnian continued his run while most of the other players were waiting for the referee to signal a free-kick for an earlier challenge.
Lazio's Diego Fuser equalised in a fine move shortly afterwards, but Juanele Castanos gave the Spaniards a 3-2 lead at the break.
The second half had barely started when there was another interchange of goals -- with Pierluigi Casiraghi equalising for the Italians before Slavisa Jokanovic restored Tenerife's lead.
Juanele knocked in a set-piece move after 62 minutes, and Tenerife hung on despite heavy Lazio pressure in a frantic final half-hour.
